property_summary: For every caller and value, if a non-owner attempts to call withdraw after any sendMoney call, the correct contract C will revert (non-owners cannot withdraw), whereas the mutant (which inverts onlyOwner) allows some non-owner to successfully withdraw and thus reduce address(c).balance for some inputs.
change_summary: Changed onlyOwner modifier to invert the check so it requires caller NOT be owner, altering access to withdrawAll.
